lines.zh: 我在竞技场的石板上滑过。
lines.en: I glide over the arena flagstones.
My feet don't touch; ki carries me.

lines.zh: 我走的每一步，都踩在节拍上。
lines.en: Every step I take lands on the beat.

lines.zh: 魔界的风绕着我的衣角转。
lines.en: Demon Realm wind curls around my hem.
I drift over, unhurried.
The pillars slide past me.

lines.zh: 我的斗篷拖在地上，像一片影子。
lines.en: My cloak drags like a shadow.

lines.zh: 我抬手，前方的碎石自己让开。
lines.en: I raise a hand and the rubble clears itself.

lines.zh: 我在这座场里绕了无数圈。
lines.en: I've circled this arena countless times.

lines.zh: 上方那道血条，是给我看的。
lines.en: That health bar overhead is for me.

lines.zh: 我在这座祭坛上睡过很久。
lines.en: I slept on this altar for a long time.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛只睁开一条缝。
lines.en: My eyes are open only a slit.

lines.zh: 气在我周身沉成一层雾。
lines.en: Ki settles around me as mist.
I know you're here.

lines.zh: 这地方的风向，从来不变。
lines.en: The wind here never changes.

lines.zh: 我抬起一根手指，又放下。
lines.en: I lift one finger, then lower it.
Sleep has made me slow.
But I don't need to be fast.

lines.zh: 竞技场的边界，我闭着眼也知道。
lines.en: I know the arena's edge with my eyes shut.

lines.zh: 我听见石缝里有虫在爬。
lines.en: I hear insects crawling in the cracks.

lines.zh: 我数了数，这里一共有七根柱子。
lines.en: I count seven pillars here.

lines.zh: 我的气息压得火把都在晃。
lines.en: My presence makes the torches waver.
I've waited long enough.
I rest a hand on the armrest.

lines.zh: 我在想，你还敢不敢再靠近一步。
lines.en: I wonder if you dare one more step.
The corner of my mouth moves. That's a smile.

lines.zh: 你站在祭坛下，抬头看我。
lines.en: You stand below the altar, looking up.

lines.zh: 你是第一个走到这么近的。
lines.en: You're the first to come this close.
Head tilted, I gauge your ki.
So thin, like a single thread.
I lean down and my shadow covers you.
You actually didn't back away.
When I speak, the air trembles.
Do you understand?

lines.zh: 我抬手指了指你，又指了指地面。
lines.en: I point at you, then at the floor.
Kneel, or die standing.

lines.zh: 我低哼一声，气有一瞬乱了。
lines.en: I grunt, and my ki falters for a moment.

lines.zh: 这一下打穿了我的护体气。
lines.en: That pierced my ki guard.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，石板碎在脚下。
lines.en: I step back and the flagstone cracks.

lines.zh: 我压住伤口，气重新收拢。
lines.en: I press the wound and my ki closes again.

lines.zh: 这点痛，我睡了这么久也没少受。
lines.en: This pain is nothing after so long asleep.
My breathing catches.
I stare at you, and my look changes.
Good. You deserve my full attention.

lines.zh: 你以为供奉能换来什么？
lines.en: What do you think offerings will buy?

lines.zh: 这点东西，放在祭坛上都嫌轻。
lines.en: This is too light even for the altar.

lines.zh: 我闻了闻，没什么值得的。
lines.en: I sniff. Nothing worth my time.

lines.zh: 你举着它，像举着一块石头。
lines.en: You hold it up like a stone.
I don't lack food; I lack rivals.
Put it down, then look up.

lines.zh: 我的胃口，比这座竞技场还大。
lines.en: My appetite is bigger than this arena.
Step back three paces and I'll accept it.
Offer it. I won't turn it down.
After this, you still have to fight.
I don't move; you bounce off.
I put a hand out and press you back down.

lines.zh: 这一撞，连灰都没扬起来。
lines.en: That bump didn't even raise dust.

lines.zh: 我低头看了看被你碰到的衣角。
lines.en: I glance at the hem you touched.

lines.zh: 我的气把冲击都吃掉了。
lines.en: My ki simply swallows the impact.
You back off too fast and fall.
I don't need to push.

lines.zh: 再近一点，我就当是开战。
lines.en: Any closer and I'll call it war.
Stand firm. Don't embarrass yourself.

lines.zh: 魔界的王座，只坐得下一个人。
lines.en: Only one can sit the Demon Realm's throne.
My kind never speaks of this.

lines.zh: 我看了它一眼，它低下头。
lines.en: I look at it once, and it lowers its head.

lines.zh: 气与气碰了一下，算是确认。
lines.en: Our ki touches once, a confirmation.
This arena is left to us.

lines.zh: 我们各守一半，互不越界。
lines.en: We keep to our halves, never crossing.
It leaves first; I remain seated.
There's a door behind the throne.
That door doesn't open for me.
Never mind. Sit.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，那块石头浮起来。
lines.en: I lift a hand and the stone rises.
I don't touch it; it comes to me.
This has some use.
I pinch it between my fingers and inspect it.
Too brittle; it crumbles.
I drop it at my feet and lose interest.

lines.zh: 我抬手一挥，它落到祭坛上。
lines.en: I wave and it lands on the altar.

lines.zh: 这点重量，我用一根手指就够。
lines.en: One finger is enough for this weight.
Keep it. It might help.

lines.zh: 掉下来的东西，都是我的。
lines.en: What falls here is mine.
You've crossed the altar's line.

lines.zh: 这就是你唤醒我的原因？
lines.en: Is this why you woke me?
My eyes are fully open now.
The health bar lights up.

lines.zh: 我站起来了，整座场都在响。
lines.en: I rise, and the whole arena rings.
Ki rises from the floor.
I've drawn you into my reach.
I extend a hand, palm down.
Burst meteors are already gathering.
This blow will close your escape first.

lines.zh: 你还有一次说话的机会。
lines.en: You have one chance to speak.
Nothing? Then we begin.

lines.zh: 魔界的竞技场，就是我的主场。
lines.en: The Demon Realm arena is my home ground.
Don't run. There's no exit.
My ki has covered the whole arena.
The countdown is over.

lines.zh: 你绕着柱子跑，柱子在我手下碎了。
lines.en: You circle a pillar; it shatters under my hand.
I drift ahead of you and block the way.

lines.zh: 你的气一乱，我就知道你在慌。
lines.en: Your ki wavers, so I know you're panicking.
I raise a hand and an afterimage stays behind.
I appear behind you.

lines.zh: 你的攻击穿过了我的影子。
lines.en: Your attack passes through my image.

lines.zh: 每一次闪避都在消耗你。
lines.en: Every dodge drains you.
I predicted your first step.
You go left; I'm already there.

lines.zh: 我慢慢抬手，气在掌心旋。
lines.en: I raise my hand slowly as ki spirals in my palm.
You won't dodge this one.
The pillars fall one by one.
The arena is shrinking.

lines.zh: 柱子全碎了，你没有掩体了。
lines.en: Every pillar is rubble — you have no cover left.
This is your limit.
Once more, and I won't hold back.
Your armor is no longer whole.
Let it end.

lines.zh: 我一掌拍下去，地面裂成三块。
lines.en: I bring a palm down and the floor splits in three.

lines.zh: 近身一击，你被推出很远。
lines.en: A close blow sends you far.
The ki blast skims the floor after you.

lines.zh: 我抬手一抓，气把你拽回来。
lines.en: I snatch with my hand and ki drags you back.
Burst meteors fall.
I press the attack and give you no breath.
That blow used thirty percent.

lines.zh: 你挡了一下，手臂应该麻了。
lines.en: You blocked one; your arm must be numb.
My ki isn't yours to block.
I step back half a pace and watch.
You can still rise. Good.
Next blow, I won't hold back.
The altar stones are shattered.
I'll remember how you bleed.

lines.zh: 祭坛上的灯忽然全亮了。
lines.en: Every lamp on the altar lights at once.
I sit up out of my long sleep.
The whole arena begins to shake.
A health bar spans the air.

lines.zh: 我的斗篷垂下来，盖住台阶。
lines.en: My cloak falls and covers the steps.

lines.zh: 气从我脚下散开，铺满石面。
lines.en: Ki spreads from my feet across the stone.
Someone has stepped into my arena.
I raise my eyes to them.

lines.zh: 魔界的门在我身后关上了。
lines.en: The Demon Realm's gate shuts behind me.
All seven pillars hum.

lines.zh: 我不知道这次来的是谁。
lines.en: I don't know who has come this time.
But I know the ending.
Stand up.
You won't walk out.
Unless you beat me.

lines.zh: 这地方，只留下过一个人。
lines.en: Only one has ever left this place.
And that was me.

lines.zh: 魔界竞技场的灯一盏盏亮起。
lines.en: The lamps of the Demon Realm arena light one by one.

lines.zh: 火焰爬上斗篷，我抖了抖。
lines.en: Flames climb my cloak and I shake them off.

lines.zh: 我撞在祭坛上，石阶碎了。
lines.en: I hit the altar and the steps break.

lines.zh: 我沉下去，气也托不住我。
lines.en: I sink; even ki can't hold me up.
The blast tears a corner off the altar.

lines.zh: 一根箭插进肩头，我把它拔了。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my shoulder; I pull it out.
Runes coil around me like chains.

lines.zh: 沉睡太久，我的气也空了。
lines.en: Too long asleep; my ki has run dry.

lines.zh: 雷落在竞技场上，我踉跄了一下。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the arena and I stagger.

lines.zh: 我坠进虚空，祭坛在上面变小。
lines.en: I fall into the void as the altar shrinks above.
